hardDeadline.description: The original hard cap, never moved.

ceilingDeadline.description: The most the extension could reach.

SellerMoneySummary.description: Collections, never invoices: a collection counts in the month its capture was confirmed and a refund in the month it happened, never rewriting an earlier period; tax excluded; one capture counted once and split shares applied once; earned, held, payable and paid kept apart; pending = held + payable as of computedAt. (owner manual 17)

sellerId.description: Seller; absent on the total row.

netAttributableRevenueCents.description: What attributed customers paid for the service, collections confirmed in the period net of refunds that happened in the period, tax excluded; never Kauro's revenue.

commissionGeneratedCents.description: Commission earned on that revenue in the period, after offsets.

commissionPendingCents.description: Earned not yet paid, as of computedAt: held plus payable.

SellerMoneySummaryPage.title: SellerMoneySummaryPage
SellerMoneySummaryPage.description: A page of SellerMoneySummary, newest first.

nextCursor.description: The cursor of the next page, when there may be one (opaque, bound to the caller, the agency, the filter and this order).

SellerOutreachRequestView.title: SellerOutreachRequestView
SellerOutreachRequestView.description: The seller reads the state of their own request; never the owner's decline code or note. (owner manual 17)

SellerOutreachRequestViewPage.title: SellerOutreachRequestViewPage
SellerOutreachRequestViewPage.description: A page of SellerOutreachRequestView, newest first.

nextCursor.description: The cursor of the next page, when there may be one (opaque, bound to the caller, the agency, the filter and this order).

SellerSchedule.title: SellerSchedule
SellerSchedule.description: The seller's own records; dates from commission.statementBusinessDay and payBusinessDay. (owner manual 17)

SellerWonCustomer.title: SellerWonCustomer
SellerWonCustomer.description: Only the seller's own converted claims; dates, never amounts of the customer. (owner manual 17)

finalCompletionAt.description: Final completion of the first project.

commissionEligibleOn.description: Eligibility date (30 days after final completion).

StatementBalanceItemView.title: StatementBalanceItemView
StatementBalanceItemView.description: An unrecovered balance a statement carries and what it waits on (design §6).

kind.description: What the balance waits on: an offset, a repayment review, a write-off or a dispute.

lineId.description: The line the balance came from.

clauseRef.description: OFFSET: the agreement clause or rule applied.

StatementBalanceView.title: StatementBalanceView
StatementBalanceView.description: The statement's balance (F-17): payable = earned − offsets + retainer − held.

StatementCsvRow.title: StatementCsvRow
StatementCsvRow.description: RFC 4180, UTF-8, one header row; a cell starting with =, +, -, @, tab or carriage return is prefixed with an apostrophe; amounts are minor units; no customer CRM data. (owner manual 17)

StatementItemView.title: StatementItemView
StatementItemView.description: One commission line of a statement: the purchase's basis, the rate and share, the cumulative entitlement, what was paid before, the adjustment and what is held (design §6).

agencyId.description: The agency whose purchase the line commissions.

sequence.description: The agency's first qualifying purchase or a repeat.

netServiceBasisCents.description: The net service basis in minor units: excess capture and tax are never basis.

rateBps.description: The commission rate in basis points.

shareBps.description: The seller's share of the entitlement in basis points.

cumulativeEntitlementCents.description: The cumulative entitlement of the line, in minor units.

adjustmentCents.description: The adjustment of this statement, in minor units.

adjustmentDirection.description: Whether the adjustment raises or lowers the payable amount; absent when there is none.

heldCents.description: What is held from this line.

holdReason.description: Why an amount is held (a server token); present with a hold.

holdReviewOn.description: The date a hold is reviewed; present with a hold.

StatementPeriodItem.title: StatementPeriodItem
StatementPeriodItem.description: One row per issued statement version; amounts are the statement's. (owner manual 17)

StatementPeriodItemPage.title: StatementPeriodItemPage
StatementPeriodItemPage.description: A page of StatementPeriodItem, newest first.

nextCursor.description: The cursor of the next page, when there may be one (opaque, bound to the caller, the agency, the filter and this order).

SupportCase.title: SupportCase
SupportCase.description: Support metadata must not become an unrestricted raw-data channel. (owner manual 18)

SupportCasePage.title: SupportCasePage
SupportCasePage.description: A page of SupportCase, newest first.

nextCursor.description: The cursor of the next page, when there may be one (opaque, bound to the caller, the agency, the filter and this order).

TransferProof.title: TransferProof
TransferProof.description: Not payment; proof of a transfer already sent, exact amount and reference; once per quote and per sealed set; never renewed; with an extension the later date applies within the ceiling, never the sum; the effective end is the earlier of five US banking days (FedACH calendar) from the accepted proof and 24 days from sealing, and that is the date the customer sees; never authorizes preparation (F-23). (owner manual 15)

holdEndsAt.description: Effective end once ACCEPTED: the earlier of five US banking days from acceptance and 24 days from sealing.

AgencySelector.name: X-Kauro-Agency
AgencySelector.description: The active agency context of a route whose path carries no agencyId (design D-SCOPE-1): a selector, never authority.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-Id
CorrelationId.description: Opaque correlation id (10 "Request envelope"): adopted when it is an id of this shape; any other value is ignored — never refused, never echoed — and the server mints one, as when it is absent (review decision E-CORR-1). Every reply carries the id the request was handled under.

CsrfToken.name: X-Kauro-CSRF
CsrfToken.description: The session's CSRF token (SessionView.csrfToken): required on an unsafe request the session cookie authenticates (B11 D-AUTH-5); refused as CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID otherwise.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required on every command (10 "Idempotency contract"); a retry after a lost response reuses it.

PageCursor.name: cursor
PageCursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page: opaque, integrity-protected and bound to the caller, the agency, the list, its filter and its order (10 "Pagination, search and exports"; R2-060). Any other cursor is CURSOR_INVALID.

PageLimit.name: limit
PageLimit.description: Page size (10 "Pagination, search and exports"; the R2 policy's api.pageDefault 25 and api.pageMaximum 100).

serviceAuth.description: A verified service identity: issuer, audience, expected identity and environment (COMMAND_CATALOGUE "Service commands require a verified service identity and audience, with scope derived from the stored operation"; package B09 D-AUTHZ-B3).

sessionCookie.name: __Host-kauro_session
sessionCookie.description: The browser session (B11 design D-AUTH-1, D-AUTH-5): Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax. An unsafe request it authenticates needs the exact application Origin, a same-origin Sec-Fetch-Site and the session's X-Kauro-CSRF token; a cookie beside an Authorization header is AMBIGUOUS_CREDENTIALS.
